theme.description: Professional, boutique consultancy, Dubai luxury real-estate vibe. No full black/dark, no purple gradients.

headings.strategy: Tight letter spacing (tracking-tighter) for massive headings. Use italic selectively for emphasis (e.g., 'Resonate.Dubai').

body.strategy: Warm humanist sans. Clean, legible, loose line-height (leading-relaxed).

layout.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-8, p-12, p-16 to give elements breathing room. Containers should have generous internal padding.
layout.grids: Bento grids with asymmetry. Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12. The hero should be broken into uneven blocks.
layout.borders: 1px solid #E2DCD0 or pure white with subtle shadow for cards.

hero.structure: Split or asymmetrical bento layout. Large typography, clear CTAs. High quality background image with bg-black/40 overlay to ensure text contrast if placed over image.
hero.ctas: Primary: Solid warm gold (#C5A059) pill or slightly rounded rectangle. Secondary: Outline dark.

services_grid.structure: Asymmetric bento grid for 7 services. Some span 2 columns, others 1. Hover effects with slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-lg.
services_grid.visuals: Use high-quality Phosphor or Lucide icons, sized large (w-8 h-8), colored in gold.

multi_step_survey.type: Counselling Funnel instead of standard Contact Form
multi_step_survey.style: Centered card with progress bar. Smooth transitions between steps. Uses Shadcn Form, Input, RadioGroup, Select.

taxi_visa_section.structure: High impact callout. Large typography ('Trusted by 1000+ drivers'). Use yellow taxi image. Background could be the dark secondary color (#2C303A) with white text and gold accents.

testimonials.structure: Static Google-style review cards. White card, 1px border, 5 gold stars, user avatar, name, 'powered by Google' text. Organized in a Marquee or Swiper carousel.

dynamic_updates.structure: Masonry or feed layout. Admin can upload success stories or videos. Cards have 'New' badges, timestamps.

admin_dashboard.structure: Protected route (/admin). Sidebar navigation (Submissions, Updates). Data tables (Shadcn Table) for survey submissions. Forms to upload updates.
admin_dashboard.style: Clean, dense data layout (Mode B high-density grid).

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure you strictly follow the .js file extensions instead of .tsx. Add data-testid to every interactive component (buttons, forms, links) for testability. Use Cormorant Garamond for main headings, Manrope for the body. Maintain luxury, high-end real-estate/consultancy vibe. Incorporate the multi-step counselling survey exactly as outlined. DO NOT use fully transparent backgrounds for headers over images - use glassmorphism with solid color bases.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Always use data-testid on interactive elements.
Do not use pure black backgrounds.
Use generous spacing (p-8 to p-24) to create a premium feel.
Do not use 'transition: all', specify targeted transitions.
Do not center align the app container globally in CSS.
Do not use transparent header over images; use solid or crystal glass (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 or bg-black/60).
Use .js files for React components, NOT .tsx.
Never use generic AI emojis in UI text.
